statement: Let W = {(a,b) | 0 <= a < m, 0 <= b < n, isWater[a][b] = 1}. For every cell (i,j), define d(i,j) = min over (a,b) in W of (|i-a| + |j-b|), and define D = max over 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n of d(i,j). The function returns a result height such that: len(height) = m; every row height[i] has length n; every entry height[i][j] is non-negative; height[i][j] = 0 whenever isWater[i][j] = 1; for every i,j with i+1 < m, |height[i+1][j] - height[i][j]| <= 1; for every i,j with j+1 < n, |height[i][j+1] - height[i][j]| <= 1; and the maximum entry of height is exactly D.
preconditions: Let m = len(isWater) and n = len(isWater[0]). The input satisfies 1 <= m <= 1000, 1 <= n <= 1000; every row of isWater has length n; for every i,j with 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, isWater[i][j] is either 0 or 1; and there exists at least one water cell, i.e. some i,j has isWater[i][j] = 1.
